name: Karaoke Portable Wireless Bluetooth Speaker with Microphone Sound System for Singing and Parties (Random Color)
description:
Turn any gathering into a live concert with the Karaoke Wireless Bluetooth Speaker and Microphone. Featuring powerful 10W stereo sound with bass diaphragm, it delivers clear, balanced audio perfect for singing, music playback, and parties. The wireless microphone and Bluetooth 5.1 connectivity make it easy to pair with smartphones, tablets, and laptops. With its rechargeable battery, lightweight design, and professional sound configuration, this portable karaoke system is ideal for indoor events, student parties, or outdoor fun.Key Features:
 Bluetooth Version: 5.1 with 10m connection range
 Power Output: 10W HD speaker with bass passive diaphragm
 Wireless Microphone: 2.4G transmission for karaoke singing
 Sound Quality: Clear vocals, balanced treble, and strong bass
 Battery: Rechargeable, suitable for parties and outdoor use
 Compatibility: Works with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and PCs
 Coverage: Professional sound, audible up to 300m²How to Use:
 Turn on the speaker and microphone
 Connect via Bluetooth to your mobile device
 Play your favorite music and sing along
 Adjust volume and microphone settings as needed
 Recharge speaker and microphone after useSafety Information:
 Keep away from water and extreme heat
 Do not overcharge battery or use damaged cables
 Use on stable surfaces to avoid falls or damage
 Keep out of reach of small children when powered on

Package Includes:
 1 × Karaoke Wireless Bluetooth Speaker
 1 × Wireless Microphone
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
